border.$description: Strokes. Carries both composite types that describe an edge: strokeStyle on its own, and border, which folds a colour and a width around one.

style.$description: Just the dash pattern. Keyword forms cover the common cases; the custom form is a dash array and a line cap.

custom.$description: A long-short dash, for anything that needs to read as provisional.

hairline.$description: The default separator, written out in full so a composite with literal sub-values exists somewhere.

strong.$description: The same composite with references in its sub-fields, which is how these are usually authored.

focus.$description: A composite whose style is itself the custom strokeStyle object rather than a keyword.
